in_sanskrit.name: Balen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong as a mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Balen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bala' which means 'strength' power, or might'. The suffix '-en' denotes 'mountain'. Hence, Balen signifies a strong and powerful individual, much like a mountain that withstands the test of time.
